title: surface-3d widget params
description: A self-contained shared renderer for drag-to-rotate 3D parametric surfaces. The renderer bundles its OWN 3D engine (rotation, orthographic projection, painter's-algorithm depth sort, Lambert shading via fill-opacity, auto-fit, and mesh decimation while dragging) — it does NOT depend on the page-global make3DDraggable/proj3 helpers, so any topic can adopt it. The author supplies only a `surf(u,v)` returning model coordinates [x,y,z] (plus optional sliders, colorOf, and readoutText) in bodyScript; the engine builds and renders the mesh.

widgetId.description: DOM id for the outer .widget wrapper.

uRange.description: [u0,u1] parameter range for the first surface coordinate.

vRange.description: [v0,v1] parameter range for the second surface coordinate.

nu.description: Mesh resolution along u (halved while dragging).

nv.description: Mesh resolution along v (halved while dragging).

color.description: Default face fill (palette token). Default var(--cyan).

sliders.description: Optional range controls; surf()/readoutText() read them via $('#id').value.

bodyScript.description: Author-supplied JS body (ARTIFACT). Must define `function surf(u,v){ return [x,y,z]; }` in model coordinates (auto-fit handles scaling). May define `function colorOf(u,v,p){ return 'var(--token)'; }` and `function readoutText(){ return '...'; }`. In scope: `$`, `SVG`, plus the slider elements by id. The engine handles all projection, rotation, shading, and decimation.
